A mailto link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Contact <a href=\"mailto:hello@example.com\">us</a> directly.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
